reports.description: Yara Novah ( Instagram - yaranovah001) reached out to me on Instagram on 29th May 2021 and introduced herself as a bitcoin trader. She told me about the bitcoin investment opportunity with https://usexperttraders.com and how I can make profit from their trading platform in 7 days. I deposited 100 USD bitcoin in the bitcoin wallet provided. The platform showed me that I can withdraw 12100 USD after 7 days. Upon submitting the request for withdrawal I was contacted by her Finance Manager Williams Matthew. He said that I will have to pay 10% as tax amount to withdraw the profit. I paid 5% of the amount to partially withdraw the profit. Once I made this transfer then I was asked to pay 1305 USD to get an International Business Permit Certificate(IBPC). I was foolish enough to pay this amount as well. I know I should have stopped. However, after receiving the IBPC it did not stop. They next asked me to pay 950 USD as insurance money. I did not pay this insurance money because by now I read more about these bitcoin scams. I have lost a total of 3000 AUD to these scammers. Their names and contact details are as follows: Williams Matthews contact number is +14062723650 and Yara Novahs contact number is +16238875478 and +17867448638.
